summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 62 of CipherBox — a monorepo-wide architectural keystone replacing legacy FolderMetadata/FileMetadata types with a unified Node codec system, including dual-sealed bodies, generation-based AAD, and TS/Rust golden vectors.
summary.outcome: Phase 62 was fully planned (9 plans, 7 waves, passed verification 15/15 dimensions after one revision), then executed through Wave 7. All 8 reported waves completed; Wave 7 (62-08b, web component layer + final pnpm typecheck gate) was spawned but the transcript ends before its result is confirmed.

repo: Consumer test files that import retired types fail tsc before describe.skip evaluates — imports must be removed entirely, not just test bodies skipped.
Vault v3 blob wire format: 0x03 | u16_BE(readLen) | ECIES(rootReadKey) | u16_BE(writeLen) | ECIES(rootWriteKey); replaces single-key v2 and removes encryptedRootFolderKey.
The cross-package dist chain must be rebuilt in dependency order (core → sdk-core → sdk → web) for downstream tsc gates to see updated types.
file-ipns.test.ts imported from ../file/derive-ipns and ../folder/metadata (retired), not from the live ipns/ module — safe to delete without losing spec coverage.
Retired type references in core source files after cutover are all migration comments, not live imports; core tsc clean is the authoritative check.
Nyquist validation requires RESEARCH.md to contain a ## Validation Architecture section before VALIDATION.md can be generated.
PATTERNS.md is not committed by the step-13d commit bundle — it must be committed explicitly as a separate step.
workflow.auto_advance=true in gsd config automatically chains plan-phase into execute-phase; must be consciously overridden for unsupervised keystone phases.
The drift precheck can flag 143+ pre-existing elements when the codebase baseline map is stale — non-blocking, but generates noise; /gsd-map-codebase refreshes the baseline.

code.finding: New unified Node/SealedChildRef/PublishedNode types and content/write-body types; fileKey carried as Uint8Array inside sealed read body.
sealNode/unsealNode compose the Phase-61 sealAesGcmAad/buildNodeAad primitive; freeze-first design means this must land before any consumer seals.
Barrel cutover: folder/ and file/ exports removed, ./node added; deleting 7 files dropped core test count from 228 to 190 (expected — retired suites).
Frozen golden vectors: body-bytes primary lock (IV-independent) + fixed-key/fixed-IV full-seal lock; reuses Phase-61 node_id/IV so Phase-69 Rust test slots in directly.
Committed cross-language vault v3 blob vector; must live in tests/vectors/ (not inline in PLAN.md) per D-04 and cross-language parity requirement.

workflow: The gsd commit helper has a known false-negative: reports commit_failed even when the commit lands cleanly; git log is the authoritative check, not the helper's exit status.

Worktree isolation was skipped for this monorepo in favor of sequential execution: worktrees lack node_modules (slow per-worktree pnpm install) and the cross-package dist chain is simpler on one tree.
When API-surface intel regenerates but extracts 0 symbols, omit it from the planner prompt entirely — it adds noise with no value.

Plan-checker iteration 1 caught: RESEARCH.md missing (RESOLVED) markers (gate blocker), vault v3 vector inline vs. committed, partial-tsc exit-code masking via trailing echo, Plan 08 over file threshold, and insufficient web test quarantine discovery scope.
Schema-gate hook scans for ORM files (Prisma/Drizzle/TypeORM/Payload/Supabase); packages/core crypto codec files are not ORM schemas — gate skips silently with no push task injected.
post-planning gap analysis (step 13e) is a no-op when no plan:post gate hooks are active in the phase config.

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative on VALIDATION.md: reported commit_failed but git log confirmed the commit landed (2475ae35d); required manual verification after every suspicious commit.
Node eval quoting bug in execute-phase init required a full re-run to extract worktree/degradation flags cleanly.
Requirements-coverage display glitch: word-splitting caused all six NODE IDs to print as a single token; required a clean re-run to get a trustworthy pass/fail result.
Drift precheck flagged 143 pre-existing elements (stale baseline map) — entirely non-actionable noise for Phase 62 planning; no way to suppress without refreshing the map.
API-surface intel hook ran and produced a file but extracted 0 symbols — a wasted subagent spawn with no output value.
open_items: 62-08b (web component layer + final root pnpm typecheck gate) was spawned but the transcript ends before its result is confirmed — execution outcome unknown.
Write-chain, share, bin, and invite behavior in sdk is stubbed to Phase 65; sdk-core has 55 quarantined tests awaiting real implementations.
registry/schema.ts and bin/types.ts stubs are scoped to Phase 65 (behavioral implementations) and Phase 66 (DB schema).
Phase 69: Rust codec test must slot into the frozen node-codec.json vectors using the committed node_id/IV.
Codebase baseline map is stale (/gsd-map-codebase not run); drift precheck will continue firing until refreshed.
phase uat-passed CLI command exists in help but has no handler implementation (pre-existing known gap from memory).
Cargo.lock not regenerated after any Cargo.toml version bumps that may accompany this phase (pre-existing release-please gap from memory).
